chapterInfo.content:
21
Esum ase awudie
1Sɛ wohunu obi a wɔaku no da wiram asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa no so, na wonnim deɛ ɔkumm no a, 2ɛnneɛ wo mpanimfoɔ ne w’atemmufoɔ mfiri adi nkɔsusu nkɔduru nkuro a ɛdeda deɛ wɔaku no no ho no so; 3na kuro a ɛbɛn deɛ wɔaku no no ho no, saa kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ mfa nantwiburuwa a wɔmfaa no nyɛɛ adwuma na ɔntwee kɔnnua pɛn, 4nsiane nkɔ subonhwa a nsuo sene wɔ mu a wɔnnɔeɛ na wɔnnuaa mu adeɛ da mu, na wɔmmu nantwiburuwa no kɔn mu wɔ subonhwa no mu. 5#Deut 17.8-9 Na Lewifoɔ mma asɔfoɔ no mmra ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi wɔn sɛ wɔnsom na wɔnhyira AWURADE din mu, na wɔn anomu asɛm so na wɔmfa nni akasakasa ne ɔborɔ ho asɛm biara; 6#Mat 27.24 na kuro a ɛbɛn deɛ wɔaku no no mu mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa nhohoro wɔn nsa ngu nantwiburuwa a wɔabu ne kɔn mu subonhwa no mu no so, 7na wɔmma wɔn nne so nka sɛ: Ɛnyɛ yɛn nsa na ɛhwiee mogya yi guiɛ, na yɛn ani anhunu. 8AWURADE fa kyɛ wo man Israel a woagye wɔn no, na mfa mogya a ɛdi bem ho afobuo ngu wo man Israel so; na fa mogya ho bɔne yi kyɛ wɔn. 9#Num 35.33 Na wo deɛ, yi mogya a ɛdi bem ho afobuo firi wo mu, na yɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so.
Mmaa a wɔafa wɔn nnommum
10Sɛ wotu sa ne w’atamfo rekɔko, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn hyɛ wo nsa, na wofa wɔn mu bi nnommum, 11na wohunu nnommum no mu baabereɛ bi, na wopɛ sɛ wofa no yɛ wo yere a, 12ɛnneɛ fa no bra wo fie, na ɔnyi ne ti, na ɔmmubu ne mmɔwerɛ, 13na ɔnyi ne dommum atadeɛ mfiri ne ho, na ɔntena wo fie nnyam n’agya ne ne na bosome mu, na ɛno akyiri no woakɔ ne ho aware no na wayɛ wo ɛyerɛ. 14Na sɛ ɛba sɛ wompɛ no bio a, ma no mfa ne ho nkɔdi sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ, na tɔn deɛ, ntɔn no nnye sika, ɛne no nnni no sɛ afenaa, ɛfiri sɛ woahodwo no.
Mmakan dibea
15 # Gye 29.30 Sɛ ɔbarima bi wɔ yerenom baanu, na ɔdɔ ɔbaako, na ɔnnɔ ɔbaako, na wɔn baanu no no wowo mma ma no, na abakan no yɛ deɛ ɔnnɔ no no ba a, 16ɛnneɛ da a ɔrekyɛ n’adeɛ mu ama ne mma no, ɔmmfa deɛ ɔdɔ no no ba nnyɛ abakan nnni deɛ ɔnnɔ no no ba a ɔyɛ abakan no anim. 17#Gye 49.3 Na ɔmmu deɛ ɔnnɔ no no ba no abakan mma no deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa mu abupɛn mmienu; na ɔne n’ahoɔden asefire, abakan dibea yɛ ne dea.
Ɔba ɔtuatefoɔ
18Sɛ obi wɔ ɔba ɔsoɔdenfoɔ ne otuatefoɔ a ɔntie n’agya ne ne na asɛm, na wɔtea no na ɔntie wɔn a, 19ɛnneɛ n’agya ne ne na nkye no mfa no mfiri adi nkɔ ne kurom mpanimfoɔ nkyɛn wɔ kuro no pono ano, 20na wɔnka nkyerɛ ne kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: Yɛn ba yi yɛ ɔsoɔdenfoɔ ne otuatefoɔ, ɔntie yɛn asɛm, ɔyɛ ohohwini ne nsabofoɔ. 21#Deut 13.10-11 Na ne kuro no mu mmarima nyinaa nsi no aboɔ mma no nwu; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu na Israel nyinaa nte na wɔnsuro.
Mmara ahodoɔ bi
22Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a ɛsɛ kum na wɔku no de no sɛne dua bi so a, 23#Yos 8.29; 10.27; Gal 3.13 ne funu no nntena dua no so anadwo, sie no da no ara; na deɛ wɔasɛne no no yɛ Nyankopɔn nnome, na woangu w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di soɔ no ho fi.

Sɛ wohunu obi a wɔaku no da wiram asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa no so, na wonnim deɛ ɔkumm no a, ɛnneɛ wo mpanimfoɔ ne w’atemmufoɔ mfiri adi nkɔsusu nkɔduru nkuro a ɛdeda deɛ wɔaku no no ho no so; na kuro a ɛbɛn deɛ wɔaku no no ho no, saa kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ mfa nantwiburuwa a wɔmfaa no nyɛɛ adwuma na ɔntwee kɔnnua pɛn, nsiane nkɔ subonhwa a nsuo sene wɔ mu a wɔnnɔeɛ na wɔnnuaa mu adeɛ da mu, na wɔmmu nantwiburuwa no kɔn mu wɔ subonhwa no mu. Na Lewifoɔ mma asɔfoɔ no mmra ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi wɔn sɛ wɔnsom na wɔnhyira AWURADE din mu, na wɔn anomu asɛm so na wɔmfa nni akasakasa ne ɔborɔ ho asɛm biara; na kuro a ɛbɛn deɛ wɔaku no no mu mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa nhohoro wɔn nsa ngu nantwiburuwa a wɔabu ne kɔn mu subonhwa no mu no so, na wɔmma wɔn nne so nka sɛ: Ɛnyɛ yɛn nsa na ɛhwiee mogya yi guiɛ, na yɛn ani anhunu. AWURADE fa kyɛ wo man Israel a woagye wɔn no, na mfa mogya a ɛdi bem ho afobuo ngu wo man Israel so; na fa mogya ho bɔne yi kyɛ wɔn. Na wo deɛ, yi mogya a ɛdi bem ho afobuo firi wo mu, na yɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so.

Sɛ wotu sa ne w’atamfo rekɔko, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn hyɛ wo nsa, na wofa wɔn mu bi nnommum, na wohunu nnommum no mu baabereɛ bi, na wopɛ sɛ wofa no yɛ wo yere a, ɛnneɛ fa no bra wo fie, na ɔnyi ne ti, na ɔmmubu ne mmɔwerɛ, na ɔnyi ne dommum atadeɛ mfiri ne ho, na ɔntena wo fie nnyam n’agya ne ne na bosome mu, na ɛno akyiri no woakɔ ne ho aware no na wayɛ wo ɛyerɛ. Na sɛ ɛba sɛ wompɛ no bio a, ma no mfa ne ho nkɔdi sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ, na tɔn deɛ, ntɔn no nnye sika, ɛne no nnni no sɛ afenaa, ɛfiri sɛ woahodwo no.

Sɛ ɔbarima bi wɔ yerenom baanu, na ɔdɔ ɔbaako, na ɔnnɔ ɔbaako, na wɔn baanu no no wowo mma ma no, na abakan no yɛ deɛ ɔnnɔ no no ba a, ɛnneɛ da a ɔrekyɛ n’adeɛ mu ama ne mma no, ɔmmfa deɛ ɔdɔ no no ba nnyɛ abakan nnni deɛ ɔnnɔ no no ba a ɔyɛ abakan no anim. Na ɔmmu deɛ ɔnnɔ no no ba no abakan mma no deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa mu abupɛn mmienu; na ɔne n’ahoɔden asefire, abakan dibea yɛ ne dea.

Sɛ obi wɔ ɔba ɔsoɔdenfoɔ ne otuatefoɔ a ɔntie n’agya ne ne na asɛm, na wɔtea no na ɔntie wɔn a, ɛnneɛ n’agya ne ne na nkye no mfa no mfiri adi nkɔ ne kurom mpanimfoɔ nkyɛn wɔ kuro no pono ano, na wɔnka nkyerɛ ne kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: Yɛn ba yi yɛ ɔsoɔdenfoɔ ne otuatefoɔ, ɔntie yɛn asɛm, ɔyɛ ohohwini ne nsabofoɔ. Na ne kuro no mu mmarima nyinaa nsi no aboɔ mma no nwu; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu na Israel nyinaa nte na wɔnsuro.

Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a ɛsɛ kum na wɔku no de no sɛne dua bi so a, ne funu no nntena dua no so anadwo, sie no da no ara; na deɛ wɔasɛne no no yɛ Nyankopɔn nnome, na woangu w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di soɔ no ho fi.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
